text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "votes.UserId denotes the user who cast the vote (its small-integer values only fall inside posts.Id because that dense surrogate key spans 1–115378), the votes table already has PostId as its real post reference, and the 91.7% containment with 0.5% coverage plus the 'UserId' name indicates the true target is a users table, not posts."}
